_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: uppercase-snake-case placeholders are replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

effect.stranger: No capability at all. The agent records the message and refuses out loud. Every unrecognised sender starts here.
effect.known: Read-only scopes only. The agent can answer questions but cannot act on anything.
effect.trusted: Every scope in the agent's grant except owner-only ones. Nothing here can reach the terminal or spend money on your behalf.
effect.owner: The full grant, including owner-only scopes. This is you. Granting it to someone else makes them you, everywhere this agent listens.

budget.noSpendCap: No spend cap on this thread

capabilityGate.title: Capability approval needed
capabilityGate.ownerOnly: Only the agent owner can answer this request.

overview.allClearDetail: No capability gate is waiting for an answer.
overview.noBudgetPressure: No thread is near its budget
overview.noBudgetPressureDetail: Threads appear here when they use 70% of their hourly turns or spend cap.
overview.noRefusalsDetail: A refusal appears here when a sender's tier leaves no permitted scope.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Every thread across every channel, governed before a turn starts.
conversations.emptyDescription: Start one here, or attach an agent to a channel and message it from your phone.
conversations.startDescription: Pick the agent you want to talk to. A new in-app thread opens with your owner tier.
conversations.pickThread: Pick a thread to read it here.
conversations.sendFailed: The message was not sent. Your draft is still here.
conversations.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
conversations.repliesLiveOn: This conversation lives on {{channel}}. Replies happen there, not here.
conversations.strangerCeiling: Someone in this room is a stranger, so the room ceiling leaves the agent no capability. It records messages and refuses out loud.
conversations.sayHello: Say hello. Your message reaches the agent under your owner tier.
conversations.threadNotFoundDetail: It may have been removed, or the link is stale. Pick a thread from the list.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Every agent this install operates: where each is reachable and what it may do.
agents.empty: Agents are profiles owned by Prompt Manager. Create one to give it a handle here.
agents.notReachable: Not reachable on any channel yet
agents.sourceUnavailable: Prompt Manager is unreachable, so this roster shows only agents with a binding here.
agents.draftDescription: Describe the job first. Nothing is written until you confirm the draft.
agents.descriptionPlaceholder: A household planning assistant that keeps the family calendar and answers questions about it
agents.draftHint: The draft proposes a name and a read-only grant. Owner-only capabilities are never proposed.
agents.reviewPlaceholder: The draft appears here once prepared.
agents.defaultGrant: Default grant: read. Owner-only capabilities are not proposed automatically.
agents.confirmWrite: Confirm and write to Prompt Manager
agents.notWritable: Prompt Manager does not expose a writable agent endpoint on this host, so the draft was not written. Create the profile with the prompt-manager CLI instead.

agentDetail.profileOwnedElsewhere: The profile is owned by Prompt Manager and held here by reference. Switchboard never stores a copy.
agentDetail.defaultGrant: This agent's descriptor declares no grant, so the default read-only grant applies.
agentDetail.descriptorGrant: Read from the agent descriptor's grant block.
agentDetail.ownerOnlyNote: Owner-only scopes are unreachable from any other tier by construction. They are not a setting that can be turned on for someone else.
agentDetail.notReachableDetail: Attach it to a channel so people can message it.
agentDetail.noThreads: No threads for this agent yet.
agentDetail.notFoundDetail: Prompt Manager has no profile by that name and nothing is bound to it here.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Every channel this install could use, ordered by how much setup each takes.
channels.emptyDetail: Add a descriptor under data/channels to register a channel.
channels.bindingDescription: A binding maps one address on this channel to one agent. Messages from that address start turns for that agent.
channels.addressPlaceholder: chat id, handle, or phone number
channels.addressHint: The sender address as the channel reports it.
channels.threadKeyHint: Leave empty to bind every room from this address.
channels.descriptorLoaded: Channel descriptors are loaded from data/channels at boot. The file is the source of truth; the database is a cache.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Everyone who has reached an agent here, and the tier each one holds.
contacts.emptyTitle: Nobody has reached an agent yet
contacts.empty: Contacts appear the first time someone messages an agent. Unknown senders start as strangers and need no action.
contacts.pickContact: Pick a contact to review their tier and rooms.
contacts.ceilingWarning: This contact is the lowest tier in {{count}} group rooms. Lowering them to {{tier}} narrows what the agent may do for everyone in those rooms.
contacts.ownerWarning: Owner is not a permission level. It makes this person indistinguishable from you to every agent they can reach.
contacts.tierChanged: Tier changed to {{tier}}. {{rooms}} room ceilings updated.

session.title: Sign in as the owner
session.description: Changing a tier, attaching an agent, answering a gate, or writing an agent profile needs the owner's credentials. They are sent to this host's authenticator and never stored here; only the issued token is kept for this tab.

call.title: Call
call.unavailableTitle: Call mode is not available in this release
call.unavailableDetail: Voice and video calls are a later target. The conversation itself is still here.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Is anything waiting on you? Gates, refusals, channel health and budget pressure, in that order.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Preferences for this browser, and the facts about this install.
settings.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow the system.
settings.descriptorStatus: {{count}} descriptors loaded from the boot-time registry.
settings.trustDescription: How every turn is admitted. These are not configurable per agent.
settings.trustRule1: Effective scope is the narrowest of sender tier, room ceiling, and the agent's grant, resolved before the agent reads the message.
settings.trustRule2: A room's ceiling is the lowest tier in it. Adding a stranger narrows the room; it never widens the stranger.
settings.trustRule3: Every thread has an hourly turn budget and a spend cap. Both fail closed and tell you once, not every time.
settings.meteringDescription: Inference runs through agent-manager with the provider keys configured on this host.
settings.byokNote: Your own provider keys are never charged. Metered inference through the business suite is an addition on top of this path and is not configured on this host.
